scope: Local paired SummerCart menu and PC runner. Outside Sodium64 master and Latest.

production_play_candidate.mode: Normal production ROM with normal manual-menu SRAM behavior.

bench_behavior: Fixed separate emulator slot. Reuses the loader and 0x104000 guest offset. Reads up to the existing 8192-byte guest SRAM seed under read-only FAT access, uses the established blank pattern for missing saves, clears the private tail, and disables automatic writeback. Avoids creating 16 unused diagnostic files during these USB frame/audio runs.

transport.reset_contract: In the local SC64 2.20.2 source, the host reset command resets cartridge configuration/CIC parameters over the same USB transport. The controller samples the N64 RESET line as input. No independent PC-accessible power/reset endpoint has been identified.
